paragraphs.source_en:
When
thou commandest me to sing it seems that my heart would break with pride; and I look to thy face, and tears come to my eyes.

units.source_en:

thou commandest me to sing it seems that my heart would break with pride; and I look to thy face, and tears come to my eyes.

ja.t: けそうになります。そして

paragraphs.source_en: All that is harsh and dissonant in my life melts into one sweet harmony—and my adoration spreads wings like a glad bird on its flight across the sea.

units.source_en: All that is harsh and dissonant in my life melts into one sweet harmony—and my adoration spreads wings like a glad bird on its flight across the sea.

paragraphs.source_en: I know thou takest pleasure in my singing. I know that only as a singer I come before thy presence.

units.source_en: I know thou takest pleasure in my singing.
I know that only as a singer I come before thy presence.

ja.t: ることができるのだと

paragraphs.source_en: I touch by the edge of the far spreading wing of my song thy feet which I could never aspire to reach.

units.source_en: I touch by the edge of the far spreading wing of my song thy feet which I could never aspire to reach.

ja.t: みえなかったあなたの

paragraphs.source_en: Drunk with the joy of singing I forget myself and call thee friend who art my lord.

units.source_en: Drunk with the joy of singing I forget myself and call thee friend who art my lord.
